**1.012: Clean-up and titles on the phone, and transcripts saved to a folder.**

- **Clean up:** Transcription Mode can tidy a finished transcript with a small on-phone model: S1-mini by Superwhisper (default) or S1-ASR-Cleanup (experimental), an optional download in Models → Add-on models. Needs an ARMv8.2 phone.
- **Save to a folder:** Save writes the transcript as Markdown to a folder you pick, in year / month / day folders.
- **Titles:** with the title model downloaded, saved transcripts get a short title.
- Add-on models are easier to find in the Models screen. Includes the 1.010 and 1.011 memory fixes.
- Not yet tested on a device. arm64-v8a only. Android 9+. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
